label: How often one person may do an action that mails people, hides work or fills the disk

params.name: rates

katha_invite_email.why: addresses one person may invite to Katha groups in a day (each is an email)

katha_invite_again.why: the same address asked again into the same group (remove + add again) - once a week

katha_claim.why: copyright claims one account may file in a day (a claim hides the work at once)

katha_circle_join.why: wrong circle codes one account may try in an hour

issue.why: issue reports (and work reports) one account may file in an hour

access_request.why: access requests one account may send in a day

params.label: Action -> {per_s: window in seconds, most: how many in that window, why: what it protects}

description_nl: 2026-10-01 portal assessment (tv / sm / katha): group invites could mail any address without limit (remove + add again re-mailed it), one account could hide any public work with copyright claims, circle codes and issue reports had no limit. ONE gate for all: core/limits.allow(action, who) counts per person per window and asks limits.room_left. An action not named here is not limited.
